card.name: Random strings in URLs and passwords
card.fires_on: The "?v" after youtube.com/watch in video links, and the characters inside random-looking codes such as hashed passwords. Also digits inside numbers in counts.

modes.label: YouTube link query
modes.description: The "?v" right after a youtube watch address, just before the video ID.

modes.label: Inside random codes
modes.description: A single character within a jumbled password hash or obfuscated string.
modes.example: User username added with password encrypted to l4<<j>>rdAL9MH0K.

modes.label: Digits in fractions
modes.description: A digit inside the count in a percent-with-fraction result.

card.writes: It promotes odd letter pairs like Vu, fh and GX, which look like pieces of random IDs.
card.plain: It fires where text turns into a random-looking code, such as a video link ID or a scrambled password.
